snippet.title: Smash Remix: Version 2.0.0 Release - EXPANSION PAK REQUIRED
snippet.description:
Smash Remix 2.0.0 has released, now featuring the voice acting of the original Smash 64 announcer Jeff Manning.

Download Page: https://smash64.online/remix

Code Registry: https://github.com/JSsixtyfour/smashremix/

Sound Test list and credits: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yeC5JkOGL7s436La4KzVDRBIdaHUcPRnj6FKSJlPgZo/edit?usp=sharing

Special thanks to Joel Haver for giving us permission to make a sequel to his famous Lanky video and to Matthew McClesky for making our dream video come to life. Please check out and support their channels:

Matthew McClesky: https://www.youtube.com/c/matthewmccleskey

Joel Haver: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVIFCOJwv3emlVmBbPCZrvw
